run_cpplint_on_files: run cpplint on one or more C++ source files to check Google C++ style compliance
run_cpplint_with_filters: run cpplint with custom filters like --filter=-whitespace,+build/include to control which warnings are reported
run_cpplint_recursive: run cpplint recursively on a directory of C++ files with --recursive flag
run_cpplint_junit_output: run cpplint with --output=junit to generate JUnit XML output for CI pipelines
run_cpplint_custom_line_length: run cpplint with --linelength=120 to set a custom maximum line length for the project
